meta.name: create-ticket
meta.description: Create a new ticket (persistent conversation/work thread) in EvoNexus. Assigns to an agent, sets priority, optionally links to a goal or project. Writes via POST /api/tickets. Use when the user says 'create a ticket', 'open an issue', 'add to Zara's queue', 'track this topic for later', 'assign X to Y agent', or wants to turn an ad-hoc conversation into persistent work.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将临时对话转为持续跟踪的工作单
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在团队中创建并分配可追踪的工作项
copy.tagline_en: Turn ad-hoc conversations into trackable work items
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to create and assign trackable work items in your team

howto.what: 装上后，当你要创建持久性任务或工单时，Claude 会询问标题、描述、优先级、处理人等字段，然后通过 API 创建工单，并说明后续处理流程。
howto.when: 当你说出“创建一个工单”、“打开一个 issue”、“添加到 Zara 的队列”等关键词，或者想把临时对话转为持久工作时触发。

say.text: 帮我开一个工单，标题是“客户投诉延迟”，优先级高，分配给 zara-cs。
say.note: Claude 会收集字段并调用 API 创建工单。

say.text: 创建一个 issue，关联 goal_id 为 3，描述附上日志内容。
say.note: Claude 会要求你确认字段并创建，然后告诉你下一步。

say.text: 把刚才的对话转成一个长期跟踪的任务。
say.note: Claude 默认使用当前对话信息创建工单。

howto.what_en: When installed, if you want to create a persistent ticket, Claude will ask for title, description, priority, assignee, etc., then call the API to create the ticket and explain next steps.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say 'create a ticket', 'open an issue', 'add to Zara's queue', or similar keywords, or want to turn an ad-hoc conversation into persistent work.

say_en.text: Create a ticket with high priority, title 'Customer complaint latency', assign to zara-cs.
say_en.note: Claude will collect fields and call API to create the ticket.

say_en.text: Open an issue linked to goal 3, description attached with logs.
say_en.note: Claude will ask for confirmation then create, and show next steps.

say_en.text: Turn this chat into a long-term tracked task.
say_en.note: Claude uses current conversation context to create a ticket.
